content: {"episode_id":"ep-05038","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal concerns the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and presyncope in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and atherosclerotic heart disease, supported by diagnosis codes G45.9, I25.10, and I49.5. Given the recent transient cerebral ischemic attack, continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of cerebral hypoperfusion and to optimize rate control. We request reconsideration of the $703.89 balance, as the authorization status was missing rather than the service being medically unnecessary."}
